MY PEPTIDES sells single research compounds and pre-combined multi-peptide sets, dispatched from the UK.

The distinguishing attribute against most of this list is that Certificates of Analysis are **publicly browsable before ordering**, at a per-product URL, rather than only shipping with an order. That lets a buyer check the testing format and the recorded purity figure while still deciding. The library also lists compounds whose COA has not yet been uploaded, which is visible rather than hidden.

The second distinguishing attribute is format: products ship as **pre-mixed solutions** rather than lyophilised powder. That removes the reconstitution step and the need to source bacteriostatic water, at the cost of requiring refrigeration on arrival and ruling out long-term frozen storage. Whether that trade is worth making depends entirely on the use case — see [pre-mixed vs lyophilised peptides](/guides/pre-mixed-vs-lyophilised-peptides/).
